claim: Replace a shift-add multiply by Z80N MUL D,E, then run the original's own final shift instructions on the product so A, flags and A' match; test exhaustively over the reachable inputs.
limit: Short loops gain little (C541: 235 -> ~205 T); a stub shift (91BA, 54 T) is slower through a trampoline.

evidence.text: C541 (object multiply) and D030 (clip 8 x 8 path) by MUL: exhaustive 4,227,201 + 65,536 cases, every register but R equal; 8 x 8 path 216 -> ~46 T; mean busy lines a sub-step 620 -> 591 with the DMA copy

next_check: A probe could compare any hook against the original routine over an input generator (mul_case is per engine).
